set.EXPERIMENT_OS_ISSUE_COMMAND: {"schema_version":1,"command_id":"lo-x4-resolve-20260824","action":"RESOLVE","actor":"claude-code","actor_role":"LIVE_OPS","payload":{"issue":"XOS-000004","resolution_summary":"Resolved by PR #256 (default branch 3c4b06d), validated in production on 2026-08-24. A series-addressed book can no longer see nothing in silence. An unknown, renamed or delisted Kalshi series returns HTTP 200 with an empty list rather than raising, so the fetch loop's except-and-warn path was never reached and FREEZE logged a healthy-shaped cycle over a universe of zero for nine days. The remedy is a shared series-addressed fetch that counts markets per configured series and classifies the cycle through a closed vocabulary - EMPTY_UNIVERSE, FETCH_FAILED, PARTIAL_FETCH_FAILURE, OK, NO_SERIES_CONFIGURED - so a zero that is a venue answer is never confused with a zero that is an incomplete fetch; plus a bounded, allowlisted funnel summary carried in the log MESSAGE, where the ops channel can actually read it, for all six series-addressed trackers. A stage that did not run renders as NOT_RUN, never as zero. Scope accepted with a recorded clarification: the 'pinned' and per-skip-reason counters named in the original plan were declined as requirements because they exceed the four-stage first-zero capability and conflict with the approved bounded allowlist for a public channel - they were not built, and this resolution does not claim otherwise."}}
